0.x: **Gandhi's fast unto death:** from **20 September 1932**, **Yerwada Jail, Poona**, against the separate electorate for the depressed classes – his **first fast unto death**.
Gandhi: separate electorates would **permanently divide Hindu society**; **Ambedkar** supported the separate electorate.
Signed by **Ambedkar** for the depressed classes and **Madan Mohan Malaviya** for caste Hindus; the government accepted it as an **amendment** to the Award; Gandhi ended his fast.
The Pact's joint electorate with reserved seats became the **model for SC reservation** (it concerned SCs, not STs).
**Bose on Ambedkar:** "leadership thrust upon him by a benign British Government" – attributed to **Subhas Chandra Bose**.

r: Founded by Gandhi; **first president G.D. Birla**, secretary **Amritlal Thakkar**; renamed **Harijan Sevak Sangh**

1.x: **Bhagya Reddy Varma:** at the **1917 Vijayawada** conference the depressed classes were to be called **Adi-Hindu**; the conference took the name **Adi-Andhra Mahajana Sabha**; worked with **Arige Ramaswamy** among the Malas; title "Varma" from the **Arya Samaj**.
**"Scheduled Castes":** first used by the **Simon Commission**, fixed by the **GoI Act 1935**, first list **1936**; SCs are also called **Dalits**.

r: The **2nd Round Table Conference** failed over minority representation
**Muslims, Sikhs, Europeans, Indian Christians, Anglo-Indians, depressed classes** (and Marathas for some Bombay seats); Buddhists had none
Declared a **minority** with a separate electorate **for the first time**; **double vote** (separate + general); **71** provincial seats
**3%** seats in all provinces except the **NWFP**

2.x: Indians were divided into **11 groups**; the Award gave each minority seats elected by **separate electorate**.
Muslims had separate electorates from 1909; Europeans, Anglo-Indians, Indian Christians from 1919.
